name: book-searchjet-mnn
description: Full-stack Google Books reading-list app: search books, sign up, and save your list. React, Apollo GraphQL, Express, MongoDB Atlas, JWT auth, tested with CI and deployed on Render.

paragraphs: A full-stack MERN app for searching the Google Books catalog and keeping a personal reading list. Users sign up, search for any title, author or topic, save books to their account, and remove them later.
Live demo: (free hosting: the first load after a break can take about a minute)
features: Search millions of books through the Google Books API, via a cached server-side GraphQL query
Save books to your account and manage your list on the My Books page
GraphQL API built with Apollo Server, with clear errors for duplicate accounts and wrong passwords
